hints.title: Run-Length Segment Pointer Advancement
hints.text: Consume elements across run-length encoded pairs by exhausting the available count of the current segment before advancing to subsequent pairs.

hints.title: Progressive Count Depletion
hints.text: While remaining requested n > 0 and pointer within bounds: if current segment count >= n, deduct n from count and return current value. Otherwise, subtract segment count from n and advance to next pair.

hints.title: RLEIterator Next Blueprint
hints.text: In next(n): while idx < len(encoding): if encoding[idx] >= n: encoding[idx] -= n; return encoding[idx + 1]. Else: n -= encoding[idx]; idx += 2. Return -1 if stream exhausted.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of run-length encoded pairs in input
complexity.notes: Pointer advances monotonically across pairs at most once throughout iterator lifetime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Decompressing into an expanded flat array exhausts memory when counts reach 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place count depletion mutates original array in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling multi-pair spanning exhausts and returning -1 upon stream end.
